Class MarcRecord

java.lang.Object
de.gwdg.metadataqa.marc.dao.record.BibliographicRecord
de.gwdg.metadataqa.marc.dao.record.MarcRecord
All Implemented Interfaces:
Extractable, Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Marc21Record, UnimarcRecord
public abstract class MarcRecord extends BibliographicRecord
Represents a MARC record (primarily used for MARC21 and UNIMARC).
